translations.u102: Users who wish to use the Services offered by Fleequid must register on the Marketplace. Registration is free and does not imply any obligation to buy or sell vehicles. By registering on the Marketplace, Users represent and warrant that they are a Professional and that the natural person carrying out the registration is of legal age and has the powers necessary to accept these General Terms and Conditions and to bind the User.
translations.u103: Participation in the Sales Events is reserved for Users who have completed the Marketplace registration process, have provided the information requested, which is complete and truthful, and have sent the documentation, if any, requested by Fleequid pursuant to this paragraph. Fleequid may request, including after registration and at any time when this proves necessary in relation to the User's operations or to the specific transaction:
translations.u104: updated Chamber of Commerce certificate or equivalent certification, specifically indicating the powers of the legal representative;
translations.u105: identity document of the individual entrepreneur or legal representative of the company and related tax code;
translations.u106: VAT number assignment certificate or other equivalent national documentation;
translations.u107: any other document reasonably requested by Fleequid for the purposes of identifying the User, ascertaining their status as a Professional or, with reference to specific Sales Event categories, verifying the possession of particular authorisations, qualifications or other technical/professional requirements provided for by law or otherwise required for participation.
translations.u108: Fleequid may, at its discretion, allow access to the Marketplace or participation in one or more Sales Events even before all the documents have been sent, reserving the right in such case to request the missing or updated documentation at any time and to restrict, suspend or revoke the User's access or operations in the event of failure to send it.
translations.u109: The Marketplace registration process implies the obligation to accept these General Terms and Conditions. Fleequid reserves the right to request, at its discretion and at any time, approval of the General Terms and Conditions in paper form or updated official documentation to prove the User's Professional status, or the continued possession of the technical and professional requirements required for certain Sales Event categories. The validity and effectiveness of the registration are subject to approval by Fleequid. Fleequid also reserves the right, at any time and at its sole discretion, to allow, restrict, suspend or exclude registered Users' access to the Marketplace or to individual features thereof, as well as to limit their operations to only those Sales Event categories for which they have demonstrated possession of the prescribed technical/professional requirements, or on the basis of the User Classification pursuant to Art. 6. Each User may have only one profile, with which one or more company contacts authorised to operate on the Marketplace may be associated. The User profile is not transferable to third parties. Registering on the Marketplace under a false identity is prohibited.
translations.u110: Once the registration process is complete, Fleequid shall provide the User with the Marketplace access credentials relating to the company contacts associated with the profile. The User undertakes to keep them strictly confidential, to ensure that they are periodically updated and to keep the list of company contacts authorised to operate on their behalf constantly up to date. The User is responsible for the use of the credentials associated with their profile and for the activity carried out through the company contacts authorised by them, as well as for the prompt revocation of the relevant authorisations when the conditions for them cease to exist, indemnifying Fleequid, to the maximum extent permitted by law, against liability arising from any improper or unauthorised use of the credentials attributable to the User or to persons connected with the User. The User is also required to keep up to date the contact details and other information provided to Fleequid for the purposes of the communications provided for in Art. 24.
translations.u111: Within the limits and conditions of these General Terms and Conditions, registered Users may make Offers to Sell, participate in Sales Events, place Bids and use the further Services made available via the Marketplace. Participation in Sales Events and the placing of Bids ordinarily require payment of the Security Deposit as provided for in Art. 6; where due, failure to pay the Security Deposit precludes the placing of the Bid. The permitted use of the Marketplace is limited to consulting the Sales Events and advertisements present, placing Offers to Sell, placing Bids and using the further Services made available by Fleequid, in the manner and for the purposes provided for in these General Terms and Conditions, the Specific Terms and Conditions, the Special Sale Terms and Conditions and any applicable Individual Contracts. Any other use of the Marketplace is expressly prohibited. In particular, activities aimed at making the Marketplace inoperable, impairing its functioning or making it more difficult for other Users to use are not permitted. Without prior authorisation from Fleequid, the data found on the Marketplace cannot be used to create databases, be systematically monitored, or used for purposes other than those permitted. Users may not use data mining programs, robots, or other programs to collect or disclose data. Each User acknowledges and agrees not to use the Marketplace to contact other Users in order to request information or documents relating to Vehicles advertised on the Marketplace or to directly conclude transactions intended to bypass Fleequid. A User acting as a potential purchaser, including the Bidder and the Buyer, further undertakes, for 24 (twenty-four) months from the first time they obtained access, through Fleequid, to information or contacts relating to the specific Vehicle or to the relevant Seller, not to use such information, contacts or business opportunities to conclude, directly or indirectly, transactions relating to the Vehicle bypassing Fleequid's involvement. Where a circumventing transaction is concluded, or in the event of conduct objectively and unequivocally aimed at concluding one, even if the transaction is not subsequently completed, the User shall pay Fleequid, by way of penalty, an amount equal to three times the Commissions that would have been due from the Buyer for the specific transaction under the applicable Fleequid Fee Schedule, without prejudice to compensation for any further damage. Where the circumventing transaction is not completed and a Sale Price to the Buyer has therefore not been determined, the Commissions relevant for the purposes of this penalty are calculated taking as the basis, in the following order: a) the price or amount proposed, agreed or otherwise objectively identifiable in the circumventing conduct; b) failing that, the Reserve Price attributable to the specific Vehicle or to the specific transaction; c) failing that too, in the Commission Sale, the MCSP relating to the specific transaction; d) in Dealer Sales, failing also the parameters referred to in letters a) and b), the Purchase Price. For the purposes of this penalty, the relevant Fleequid Fee Schedule is in any case the one in force at the time when the User first obtained access, through Fleequid, to the information or contacts relating to the specific Vehicle or to the relevant Seller; subsequent amendments to the Fee Schedule do not affect the quantification of the penalty. Neutral or occasional contacts, or contacts lacking any objective circumventing purpose, do not constitute a violation. Where the specific transaction is structured as Dealer Sales, the Fleequid Fee Schedule relating to the Commissions payable by the Buyer is relevant exclusively as an agreed parameter for quantifying the penalty and does not give rise to the accrual of Commissions. This penalty is coordinated with the further penalties provided for in these General Terms and Conditions in accordance with Art. 15.8. Fleequid reserves the right to obscure or block, temporarily or permanently, access to the Marketplace or participation in one or more Sales Events if, in its sole discretion, it suspects that the data provided by the User is unlawful, untrue, incomplete, incorrect, out of date or false; that the Vehicles subject to the Offer to Sell are of suspicious origin; that the Bids placed are suspicious, anomalous, illicit or abusive; that the User has not paid the amounts due to Fleequid; that there are disputes by third parties regarding the data provided; that abnormal logins to the User's profile have been detected; that third parties have come into possession of the access credentials; or that the Marketplace or the data contained therein have been used for purposes that are illicit or otherwise not compliant with these General Terms and Conditions.
translations.u112: Fleequid shall promptly communicate to the User in writing the measures taken pursuant to Art. 5.5 above, stating the reasons for them. Depending on the nature and seriousness of the circumstances found, Fleequid may immediately take the measures necessary to bring to an end or contain the situation complained of, or call on the User to remedy it within a period of 30 (thirty) days. If that period expires without the situation having been remedied, Fleequid may suspend or block the User's profile, including for an indefinite period, or restrict the User's access to the Marketplace and to the related Services. The said period shall not apply where: a) Fleequid is required to comply with a legal or regulatory obligation or with an order of the competent authority which requires the immediate cessation or restriction of the supply of Vehicles or Services to the User; b) the conditions are met for the immediate termination of the Contract under the law or these General Terms and Conditions; c) the User has repeatedly breached the rules of use of the Marketplace; d) the data or content attributable to the User is unlawful or inappropriate, or the User's conduct may compromise the security or proper functioning of the Marketplace, of Fleequid or of the other Users; e) the conduct is connected with fraud, counterfeiting, infringements relating to personal data, spam or other unlawful or abusive activities. In such cases Fleequid may take the measure without prior formal warning, while still providing the User with the reasons for it. The User Classification referred to in Art. 6 does not constitute a measure within the meaning of this paragraph and is not subject to the procedure provided for herein. Likewise, the restriction or suspension of the operation of the account ordered in respect of a Buyer who is in delay or in default pursuant to Art. 12.10 constitutes an independent measure, governed by that provision, is not absorbed into the procedure provided for in this paragraph and is not subject to the related conditions and time limits.
translations.u113: In the event of two or more violations by the User of the obligations or prohibitions provided for in Art. 5.5, Fleequid may permanently block the User's access to the Marketplace, deactivate the User's profile and terminate, pursuant to Art. 1456 of the Italian Civil Code, the Contracts in progress with the User concerned, with the exception of the Sales Contracts relating to sales for which the Binding Agreement has already been concluded, which remain governed by the following sentence, by means of written notice declaring its intention to rely on this express termination clause, without prejudice to the rights and obligations already accrued. Termination under this paragraph prevents the User from initiating new transactions and may bring about the cessation of the User's general relationships with Fleequid, but does not in itself entail the Cancellation of the sales for which the Binding Agreement has already been concluded, including those relating to Vehicles in Optioned Status: with regard to such transactions the obligations of the Parties continue until they have been settled, and the Cancellation of the Sale may be ordered only where a specific ground provided for in these General Terms and Conditions arises. Delay in payment or non-payment of sums owed by the User does not, in itself, constitute a violation relevant for the purposes of the repetition referred to in this paragraph, and remains subject to the specific consequences provided for in Art. 12, including the measure referred to in Art. 12.10; this is without prejudice to the case in which the User's conduct independently constitutes one of the violations provided for in Art. 5.5.
translations.u114: Where Fleequid exercises the right of termination provided for in Art. 5.7 above, the User shall pay Fleequid, by way of penalty, the amount of €3,000.00 (EUR three thousand/00), without prejudice in any case to the right to compensation for any further damage suffered. This penalty is independent of any penalties due for the individual violations of Art. 5.5, is cumulative with them and is due only once for each termination ordered pursuant to Art. 5.7.
translations.u115: Fleequid's internal complaint management system can be accessed using the contact details on the Marketplace, as well as by sending a communication to the e-mail address claims@fleequid.com. This system is structured in accordance with Art. 11 of Regulation (EU) 2019/1150, which Fleequid also applies on a voluntary basis where it is not directly applicable. Pursuant to Art. 12 of the aforementioned Regulation, any dispute relating to the application of the provisions of this article shall be devolved to a mediation attempt by the Mediation Chamber at the Chamber of Commerce of Como, with which Fleequid declares its intention to collaborate, for the purposes of a mediation attempt managed with a natural person mediator designated and operating according to the provisions of the mediation regulation of the said Chamber of Commerce, which the User can consult in the relevant section of its institutional website. The rules governing the complaint procedure relating to Vehicles referred to in Art. 20 remain unaffected.
translations.u116: The User acknowledges and agrees that their right to use the Marketplace is subject to the limits inherent in the information technology and communication systems available and that Fleequid cannot guarantee the continuous and uninterrupted availability of the Marketplace, its operation or its use free from errors, interruptions or technical defects. To the maximum extent permitted by law, the Services and features made available by Fleequid via the Marketplace are used and enjoyed at the User's own risk; this provision constitutes a risk allocation rule and does not entail any exemption from liability for wilful misconduct or gross negligence on the part of Fleequid. To the same extent, Fleequid is not liable for damage or consequences arising from defects, malfunctions, interruptions or disruptions of the Marketplace, or from anomalies in the conduct of Sales Events attributable to technical or programming problems, to problems of connection to computer networks or to the functioning of third-party systems and services, except in the case of wilful misconduct or gross negligence on the part of Fleequid. The same limitation applies to Fleequid's employees, representatives, agents and attorneys, within the limits permitted by law. This is without prejudice to Fleequid's right to grant an extension of the Payment Period pursuant to Art. 11.7 in the event of a disruption that has actually prevented or hindered timely performance, and to the provisions of Art. 6.5 concerning attributability for the purposes of the User Classification.
translations.u117: Users may at any time request the deletion or rectification of their Marketplace profile, in compliance with the applicable data protection legislation, by contacting Fleequid customer service using the contact details available on the Marketplace or by following the instructions provided in the relevant section. Before proceeding, Fleequid may request additional information to verify the User's identity. Once the cancellation process is complete, the information associated with the User's profile, except that required to comply with legal obligations or for security, fraud prevention, and other purposes compliant with data protection legislation, shall be removed from the system. Fleequid shall also proceed with the cancellation of the profile following receipt of a notice of withdrawal from the User pursuant to Art. 4.2. If, at the time of the request for deletion or of the withdrawal, the User is involved in a Sales Event, has made an Offer to Sell or a Bid, is a party to a transaction for which the Binding Agreement has already been concluded or has other obligations still outstanding towards Fleequid or other Users, Fleequid may defer or restrict the deletion of the profile until the relevant relationships have been concluded and the obligations undertaken have been performed.
translations.u118: Following registration on the Marketplace and the User's performance of at least one of the following activities: (i) the submission of at least one Bid in the context of a Sales Event; or (ii) the publication of at least one Vehicle by way of an Offer to Sell, the User grants Fleequid, pursuant to and for the purposes of the applicable industrial property legislation, a non-exclusive, royalty-free, revocable, non-sublicensable licence of use, limited in time to the duration of the contractual relationship and, after its termination for any reason, for a further period of 24 (twenty-four) months, in respect of the company name, trademark, logo and other distinctive signs of the User (the “Distinctive Signs”), exclusively for purposes of institutional and commercial communication, marketing and promotion of the Marketplace and of the Services offered by Fleequid. Within such scope, Fleequid is expressly authorised to mention the User as an entity registered on the Marketplace or as a user of the Services, including with reference to selling, purchasing or Sales Event participation activities, and to use the relevant Distinctive Signs, including by way of reproduction and publication on websites, digital platforms, commercial presentations, promotional materials, communications to customers or prospective customers, as well as through social media channels and other means of communication, within the limits set out in this paragraph. Fleequid's use of the Distinctive Signs shall comply with the principles of professional fairness and with the distinctive and reputational function of such signs, and shall in no event be capable of generating confusion among the public as to the existence of relationships of control, affiliation, partnership, joint venture, sponsorship or endorsement between Fleequid and the User, other than the mere objective circumstance of registration or use of the Services. Any use of the User's Distinctive Signs that may be denigratory, misleading or otherwise prejudicial to the User's image, reputation or commercial positioning is in any event excluded, as is any use that exceeds the strictly informative and promotional purposes of the Marketplace. With reference to the period following termination of the relationship, the use of the Distinctive Signs is permitted exclusively in connection with informational, promotional and commercial materials already produced or in the process of being distributed as at the date of termination, as well as for historical reference and commercial portfolio purposes, to the exclusion of any new active use that could portray the User as a current customer of Fleequid. This authorisation does not entail any transfer, grant or recognition of further rights over the User's Distinctive Signs, which remain the exclusive property of the User, nor does it confer on Fleequid any right of registration, filing or autonomous exploitation thereof. The User may at any time object, on justified grounds, to the use of its Distinctive Signs or to the mention of its name as a customer of Fleequid by means of written communication sent to the addresses indicated in Art. 24; in such case, Fleequid undertakes to cease such use within a reasonable period from receipt of the request, save for materials already published and not susceptible of modification or removal by ordinary means.
translations.u120: Ordinarily, the placing of a Bid is subject to payment of the Security Deposit. Fleequid may, however, provide for exemptions, differentiated amounts or different payment conditions in relation to certain categories of Users, Vehicles or Sales Events, also taking into account the User Classification. In any case, any obligation to pay the Security Deposit and the relevant amount are made known to the Bidder before the Bid is placed, via the Marketplace or through the different channel used for the specific transaction, as provided for in Art. 3.2, letter c). Where due, failure to pay the Security Deposit precludes the placing of the Bid.
translations.u121: The amount of the Security Deposit is determined by Fleequid according to the Sales Event, the characteristics and economic value of the Vehicle, the risk associated with the specific transaction and, where applicable, the User Classification. These General Terms and Conditions do not set a rigid and uniform standard amount. Without prejudice to the conditions ordinarily applied and to any preferential terms or exemptions granted by Fleequid, the User Classification may entail the application of differentiated deposit regimes, arranged according to the type of Vehicle and of Sales Event and ordinarily structured as follows: (i) first-level deposit regime: €2,000.00 for Vehicles intended for scrapping; €1,000.00 for 1 Euro Auctions; €1,000.00 for Vehicles with a Reserve Price of up to €50,000.00; €2,000.00 for Vehicles with a Reserve Price exceeding €50,000.00; (ii) second-level deposit regime: €2,000.00 for any Sales Event. The application of one of the above regimes, or of a different amount determined pursuant to the first sentence, does not require any specific title or designation to be assigned or communicated to the User, without prejudice to the provisions of Art. 6.1 concerning the prior disclosure of the payment obligation and of the relevant amount, which shall in any case prevail over the amounts ordinarily applied.
translations.u122: The Security Deposit serves as security for the performance of the obligations undertaken by the Bidder and for any claims of Fleequid relating to the specific transaction, and constitutes neither a penalty nor an independent basis for any charge. If the Bidder does not become the Buyer, the Security Deposit shall be returned in full, without interest, within 3 (three) days from the time the Bid ceases to be binding. If the Bidder becomes the Buyer, the Security Deposit shall be returned in full, without interest, within 3 (three) days from verification by Fleequid of full performance of the payment obligations relating to the transaction. In the event of Cancellation of the Sale for a reason attributable to the Buyer, or in the other cases in which sums are owed to Fleequid pursuant to these General Terms and Conditions, Fleequid may retain the Security Deposit and apply it, in whole or in part, to the payment of penalties, interest and any other amount contractually owed; any excess shall be returned to the User, without interest, within 3 (three) days from the determination of the sums owed. The Security Deposit is distinct from the Advance Payment referred to in Art. 13, as well as from any payments on account of the price or other payments due in the context of the specific transaction.
translations.u123: The User Classification is an internal, operational and dynamic status, assigned by Fleequid on the basis of objective factors relating to the User's history and to the User's conduct in using the Marketplace and in performing previous transactions, including in particular: the performance history; the Cancellations of the Sale attributable to the User; the conduct on the Marketplace; the overall course of the transactions concluded; any other factor objectively relevant for the same purposes. The Classification may be changed by Fleequid for the better or for the worse, serves exclusively operational purposes and does not entail the assignment of any designation or title to the User, or its communication to the User. The Classification relates to the registered entity as a whole and applies regardless of which company contact operates on the Marketplace on its behalf from time to time.
translations.u124: For the purposes of the User Classification, particular importance attaches to the Cancellation of the Sale resulting from non-payment attributable to the Buyer. The mere fact that the Payment Period has been exceeded, where payment is made before the Cancellation of the Sale, does not in itself entail the application of a more onerous deposit regime. Furthermore, Cancellations or the failure to conclude the transaction resulting from an act of the Seller, from disruptions of the Marketplace or from other causes not attributable to the Buyer are not taken into account for the purposes of a downgrading of the Classification.
translations.u125: In addition to the application of the deposit regimes provided for in Art. 6.2, the User Classification may entail the amendment or withdrawal of any preferential terms granted by Fleequid on a discretionary basis. The Classification may affect the Security Deposit but is not to be identified with it and is not a necessary precondition for it. The Classification does not, in itself, entail the suspension or blocking of access to the Marketplace, which remain governed by Art. 5, or the restriction of operations provided for in Art. 12.10, which constitutes a separate and independent measure; the said measures may be applied cumulatively where their respective conditions are met. In any case, the User must be able to know, before the Bid is placed, the actual effects of the Classification on the specific transaction, and in particular on the obligation to pay and on the amount of the Security Deposit, as provided for in Arts. 3.2, letter c), and 6.1.
translations.u127: When registering on the Fleequid Marketplace, registered Users declare that they have read the Privacy Policy in compliance with the laws in force and with the requirements of Art. 13 of Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR), which can be found at the following address: https://fleequid.com/it/privacy-policy. Personal data is processed in compliance with all precautionary measures to ensure its security and confidentiality, in accordance with the provisions of the GDPR, for the purposes indicated in this Privacy Policy, which also indicates and clarifies the rights of data subjects and the procedures they can activate in relation to their personal data.
translations.u128: Where the User requests access to a Financing Solution pursuant to Art. 22, the personal data of the contacts indicated by the User may be communicated to the Financiers and to the other parties involved in the relevant application, within the limits, for the purposes and on the legal basis indicated in the Privacy Policy and in the information made available in the relevant application process. The details of the processing of personal data remain governed by the Privacy Policy and by any applicable Specific Terms and Conditions.
translations.u129: Registered Users can subscribe to the Fleequid newsletter. Users can unsubscribe at any time by selecting the corresponding option in the newsletter received. By agreeing to receive the newsletter, Users agree to receive updates on new Sales Events, new initiatives, or new Services managed by the Marketplace, in accordance with the Privacy Policy.

new_terms.why: Concetto nuovo (art. 6.2, 6.5, 6.6); costruito su 'Security Deposit', resa standard.

new_terms.it: operazione elusiva / condotta elusiva / finalità elusiva
new_terms.tr: circumventing transaction / circumventing conduct / circumventing purpose
new_terms.why: Concetto nuovo (art. 5.5); v8 EN 6.11 usa 'to circumvent Fleequid's intermediation'. 'Aggirare Fleequid' resta 'bypass Fleequid' come nella v8 4.5.

new_terms.it: fatto salvo il risarcimento del maggior danno
new_terms.tr: without prejudice to (the right to) compensation for any further damage

new_terms.why: v8 EN (clausola di approvazione specifica finale).
'wilful misconduct' da v8 EN 4.10; 'gross negligence' resa standard di colpa grave (nuova nell'articolo).
Scelta nuova per distinguerlo da 'malfunzionamenti' = 'malfunctions' nello stesso periodo (art. 5.10, 6.5); la v8 4.10 rendeva 'disservizi' con 'malfunctions'.
v8 EN 4.6: 'previous paragraph'; 'primo periodo', 'periodo successivo' = 'first sentence', 'following sentence'.
Resa standard; 'measure' è già usato per i provvedimenti adottati da Fleequid.
Resa naturale; 'in senso sia migliorativo sia peggiorativo' = 'for the better or for the worse'.

notes: u102: 'dichiara e garantisce' reso 'represent and warrant' (formula già usata dalla v8 EN 6.x: 'the Seller represents and warrants'); la v8 4.1 aveva 'guarantee' per il solo 'garantisce'. Mantenuto il plurale 'Users... they' della v8.

u106: 'certificato di attribuzione della partita iva' reso 'VAT number assignment certificate' (v8: 'VAT registration certificate' per 'certificato di registrazione'); in inglese corrente le due formule indicano lo stesso documento: se si preferisce la continuità si può lasciare 'VAT registration certificate'.
u104-u107: iniziale minuscola come nell'IT v9 (elenco retto dai due punti di 5.2); eliminati dalla v8 il termine dei sei mesi e 'and possibly'.
u111: 'Offerte' reso sempre 'Bids' (la v8 4.5 in un punto aveva 'Offers made by the User', impreciso). 'Proposte di vendita' = 'Offers to Sell'.
u112, u113, u114: 'violazioni' = 'violations' come nella v8 4.6-4.7; '30 (trenta) giorni' = '30 (thirty) days' (giorni lavorativi per definizione dell'art. 1).
u113: 'reiterazione' reso 'repetition'; 'cessazione dei rapporti di carattere generale' reso 'cessation of the User's general relationships with Fleequid'.
u114: importo secondo la convenzione v8 '€3,000.00 (EUR three thousand/00)' (una sola barra come nell'IT v9; la v8 aveva '//00' per refuso).

u115 e u127: seguita la formattazione dell'IT v9 (e-mail solo in grassetto, URL senza grassetto); la v8 EN aveva grassetto+sottolineato. In u115 il link 'here' della v8 non esiste più (ora rinvio alla 'relevant section of its institutional website').
u117: mantenuta l'alternanza v8 'deletion'/'cancellation' del profilo nei punti non modificati.
u118: mantenuto 'its' riferito allo User come nella v8 4.12; negli altri paragrafi 'their' come nel resto della v8.
u121, u123: 'qualifica o denominazione' reso 'title or designation' per non usare 'status', che è la parola con cui è definita la Classificazione ('stato' = 'status').
review: u109: 'analogous agreement to the General Terms and Conditions' → 'approval of the General Terms and Conditions in paper form' — errore evidente della v8: 'approvazione analogica' è l'approvazione in forma non digitale (cartacea, con firma autografa), non un 'accordo analogo'; la resa v8 cambiava il senso della facoltà di Fleequid. Da far validare (alternativa: 'in hard copy with a handwritten signature').

u111: 'as a conventional parameter' → 'as an agreed parameter' — 'convenzionale' qui vale 'pattizio', non 'consueto'; 'conventional' è un calco fuorviante; allineato alla resa della frase gemella in un altro blocco ('exclusively as an agreed parameter for quantifying the penalty').

u112: 'personal data breaches' → 'infringements relating to personal data' — l'IT v9 dice 'violazioni in materia di dati personali' (violazioni della disciplina), più ampio del 'personal data breach' in senso GDPR (violazione di sicurezza).
u116: 'the right to use the Marketplace' → 'their right to use the Marketplace' — ripristinata la resa v8 dell'incipit, invariato in IT.
u116: 'are used at the User's own risk' → 'are used and enjoyed at the User's own risk' — 'utilizzati e fruiti': endiadi dell'IT resa per intero (nessuna omissione).

u118: ripristinate tre virgole della v8 ('Within such scope, Fleequid'; 'of such signs, and shall'; 'in such case, Fleequid') — punteggiatura inglese della resa pubblicata, non toccata dal diff in senso sostanziale.
